text_copy_1139286102.text: JR45 Year of Learning

text.text:
JR45, Year of learning, is Stryker’s interactive and on-demand monthly education series focused on the latest techniques and technologies in hip and knee arthroplasty. 

JR45 is designed to accompany fellows on their journey to practice with on-demand e-learning content plus live monthly 45-minute faculty-led webinars. Each webinar will feature orthopaedic case reviews, decision making discussions with faculty and bonus faculty pearls on the business of orthopaedics at the end of the 45-minute session. 

  • Fellows, advanced residents, and surgeons register only one time to access all or any part of the education series 
  • Registrants can join the series at any point throughout the year 
  • Unique e-learning and webinar content will be unlocked each month. E-learning available now … 
    • What would you do? Complex total knee 
    • Simplifying revision knee 
    • What would you do? Complex total hip 
  • Registrants will be notified about new e-learning content and invited to watch that month’s webinar 
  • Webinars will be available on-demand for 48 hours 
  • Content will stay unlocked for the duration of the year, so registrants can catch up on what they missed or revisit particular content.
